{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = sales_df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = sales_df.duplicated().sum()

# Check the distribution of the 'channel' column
channel_dist = sales_df['channel'].value_counts()

# Check the distribution of 'converted' by channel
conversion_by_channel = sales_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Summary statistics for converted
converted_summary = sales_df['converted'].mean()

# Print results
missing_values, duplicates, channel_dist, conversion_by_channel, converted_summary"}
